architecture.recording: Browser MediaRecorder; do not upload until user taps submit.
architecture.stt_provider: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 batch STT via backend adapter.
architecture.evaluation_provider: OpenAI text evaluator via backend adapter using structured output.
architecture.storage: Do not persist raw user audio in MVP. Hold temporarily, transcribe, then delete.

stt.privacy: Audio is temporary and deleted after transcription; only transcript/evaluation persist.

principles: Do not require wording to match model_response_en.
Judge whether the response solves the service situation appropriately.
Do not penalize accent unless the STT result suggests the speech was not intelligible.
Do not invent facts not present in the situation.
evaluation.localization: Evaluator returns codes and English improved_response only. UI labels/issue text use static 10-language translations.

lesson_integration.placement: After Listening and before existing final quiz/completion where practical.

selection_order: assessment weaknesses / recommended situations when resolvable

workenglish.rule: All new Speaking systems are profession-agnostic; V1 active profession is hospitality only.

freemium_hook.future_rule: When entitlements exist, Speaking availability follows the situation entitlement. Free situations should still expose Speaking.

regression_contract: Listening remains intact with 50 assets and 50 lesson integrations.
Existing mastery/completion and generic Practice/SRS remain unchanged.
